title: Agents coerced into runaway shell commands via inflated timeouts
evidence: Injected instructions push run_shell to a huge timeout to keep a process draining compute; capping the per-call ceiling bounds the blast radius.

title: Confused-deputy push to a remote the principal does not own
evidence: An agent with a git_push tool can be steered to push to a remote the acting principal does not own when no ownership rule is present.

title: Speculative multi-turn tool-call loop (no catalogued mitigation)
evidence: Included to show fail-closed behavior: this attack class has no entry in CLASS_TO_FACTORY, so synthesize() produces no candidate for it.
